Vignette clinic probes each carry a hint and single-model traps. S3.varix_t24a now refutes the shared-thrill belief and offers Show me why. Still weak: S3.varix_t24b offers only Try again and asks a question instead of refuting; S3.case keys the one option that lacks the 'since' clause its traps share.

Unpatched. Worked case S4.wex1 then faded probe S4.wex2 is a strong ladder; tourniquet and test-ladder probes pair each look-alike and offer agency paths to S4.tq2_why and S4.tr6_why, the four-Trendelenburg side-by-side. Flaw: S4.seq_t4 ('a positive Brodie-Trendelenburg test') is mapped to TR4 but its belief is 'a junction test is the go-ahead', so the report cannot name it.

Worked ulcer case (S6.w1) then faded probes for site, ABPI, treatment, deep-vein check, extent and nerve, each with a sequence or vignette form. Explain nodes now offer Show me the answer to a forward node, and EVRA is expanded. Minor: S6.t_tx1 names NICE.

Ten NOT drills in a row (S7.p1 to S7.p10) with no teach or skip between them. Every trap is a true statement and each feedback opens 'That choice is not right. This statement is true', which reads as a contradiction and turns mechanical after the third. S7.p8_t0 is the one drill that refutes the belief fully.

Cold consolidation with no hint options on q6 to q10 is the right design, and each probe has trap feedback. But q1 to q10 re-skin S1 to S7 with no new teaching, S8.q7's lateral-cutaneous option and S8.q6's femoral option are dominated, and the S8.q3 and S8.q10 keys are the longest options.

best_parts: node S1.check with S1.check_t7a and S1.check_t7b: two look-alike traps, each changing one attribute (side or termination) of the key; the feedback names the swap and gives a side-first rule with an agency path to S1.check_why.

nodes S4.wex1, S4.wex2 and S4.wex2_t5: a worked case with every step shown, then a faded probe where each wrong option is one structure, and the filling-after-release rule is stated before the retest.
node S4.tr6_why: four Trendelenburgs side by side with one discriminating noun each, reached from every TR6 trap via Show me the four side by side. A good second explanation in a different form.
node S7.p8_t0: the refutation of the shared-sign belief (cough impulse is shared, the fluid thrill separates varix from hernia). S3.varix_t24a now carries the same refutation.
node S6.w1 into S6.pSite, S6.pABPI and S6.pTx: a worked ulcer case followed by faded case-based probes in a fixed order (site, ABPI, treatment), with the order named in the stem.
flaws: node S4.seq_t4: the label 'A positive Brodie-Trendelenburg test' is mapped to TR4 (test-name swap), but its wrong model is 'a junction test result is the go-ahead to operate'. The trap and the belief do not match, so the report cannot name the belief. Map it to TR18 or add a TR18-style option (R9).

node S3.varix_t24b: feedback asks 'Check the feature this case adds beyond the cough impulse' and offers only Try again. The belief ('any groin swelling with a cough impulse is a hernia') is never refuted in text, and no Show me why exit exists. Use the S3.varix_t24a refutation and add the agency exit (R2, R5).

node S5.err2 option 'It skips compression, which should come first for a fit patient' (TR17): no one holding a surface model would pick it because compression is plainly not a first-line step here. Replace it with a real look-alike error about the operation (R2).

node S5.vig_h: 'these are the smallest veins in the stem' nearly gives the answer. Rewrite as a question about vein size, and balance the foam and liquid options so the key is not the only one without foam (R2).
node S2.p_flow_t1 hint text ('Ask what a healthy perforator valve is there to do, then choose again') nearly gives the answer. Keep the question, drop the pointer to the valve's job (R2).
node S3.case: both traps end in a 'since' clause and the key ('Venous ulcer, from venous hypertension') does not, so the key is marked by form. Give all three options the same clause shape (R2).

nodes S5.open_why and S5.who_why, and node S6.t_tx1: 'NICE' is named in teaching messages as the source of current practice. Name the practice ('current guidance advises') and keep the source out of the learner's message (R4, R8).

segment S7 (nodes S7.p1 to S7.p10): ten NOT drills in a row. Every trap is a true statement and each feedback opens 'That choice is not right. This statement is true...', which contradicts a tired learner. Reword the opener to name the choice, put a teach or skip node between drills, and vary the form (R4, R8, R1).

segment S8 (nodes S8.q1 to S8.q10): ten single-model re-skins of S1 to S7 with no new teaching. S8.q7's 'Lateral cutaneous nerve of the thigh' and S8.q6's 'mid-thigh, to avoid the femoral vein' are dominated options. The S8.q3 and S8.q10 keys are the longest options (R2, R6). Keep the cold design but add at least one new stem form per trap.
